title: Enhancement of surface tribology, mechanical, and electrical properties of UHMWPE via graphene nanoplatelets coating and electron beam irradiation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26756-26765
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04349B, Paper

Thitisorn Anekratmontre, Doonyapong Wongsawaeng, Grittima Kongprawes, Donruedee Toyen
This work aims to study the enhancement of tribological, mechanical, and electrical properties of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) via surface modification using graphene nanoplatelet (GNP) coating and electron beam irradiation.
